basis: Component nominal values are read from checked-in native KiCad, not this file.
vin_note: 8V is a protected-node low-line screening point after the input diode; NOT a new input connector rating (9-15V SELV).

buck.frequency_status: SENSITIVITY_ONLY: datasheet specifies 500kHz typical and +/-6% FSS, not guaranteed 450/550kHz bounds
buck.theta_status: 89 is DS41326 p4 single-layer test-board figure; 120 is layout sensitivity, neither proves actual PCB thermal behavior

ldo.set_current_status: LT3045 RevD p3 / LT3094 RevB p4 full electrical-condition min/max, not initial +/-1%
ldo.gnd_current_status: 500mA table maxima used as conservative screening at lower budget loads; not claimed characterized bounds at every load
ldo.theta_status: 33 is vendor MSE reference figure; 80/120 are copper/layout sensitivity

cuk.frequency_status: 1.8/2.0/2.2MHz is an engineering sensitivity band; Rev D p3 gives 1.85/2.0/2.15MHz at VIN=24V, not a measured oscillator range on this board
cuk.output_load_note: 0.12A negative DAC budget plus LDO ground-current/bleeder allowance; must be rechecked with exact DAC loading
cuk.feedback_source: LT8330 Rev D p3, FBX<0: -0.820/-0.800/-0.780V; bias +/-10nA; line regulation max 0.015%/V, reference VIN=12V. https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/lt8330.pdf
cuk.ccm_validity_source: Diode-current sum criterion for uncoupled inductors, small capacitor ripple approximation; Madrid et al., Sensors 2021,21,7434 DOI:10.3390/s21227434. Failure invalidates CCM formulas; positive margin does not qualify silicon.

mlcc.aging_status: 3% scenario only; actual part/class/time-after-deaging must be supplied
mlcc.curve_status: BLOCKED: no part-specific DC-bias curve imported; 22uF printed on BOM is not effective capacitance

dac.source: AD3542R RevC electrical/AC conditions pp4-6, recommended headroom/footroom p5
